class.name: CrowdAnimationBudgetGovernor
class.brief_description: Adaptively limits optional crowd IK work when main-thread frame processing is overloaded.
class.description: An opt-in, bounded numerical governor for the microsecond allowance used by [CrowdAnimationTierPlanner.cap_full_pose_cost]. Inspired by Unreal Engine's Animation Budget Allocator, but only controls optional procedural IK. It never changes animation tiers by itself, skips a combat pose, modifies scene objects or changes network/physics simulation. The caller reports each completed frame's main-thread CPU processing time, ideally from [Performance] monitor [constant Performance.TIME_PROCESS], converted to microseconds. A quarter-weight smoothed sample triggers a 25 percent optional budget reduction after two consecutive 12-sample high-pressure windows (greater than 95 percent of target). Three 12-sample low-pressure windows (below 70 percent) restore one eighth of the configured maximum per step. The unchanged neutral band avoids flickering. The floor of an enabled nonzero allowance is 25 percent of the maximum (at least 1 microsecond). This is a soft predictive policy, not real-time deadline enforcement: other workloads, GPU waits and animation mixer time are outside the measured pose-work allowance.

link.title: Animation Budget Allocator in Unreal Engine

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets the optional full-pose budget (0–100000 microseconds) and CPU process-time target (1000–100000 microseconds). Returns [code]false[/code] without changing current state for malformed settings. Reapplying identical settings preserves samples and pressure; changing either setting resets all evidence and restores the configured allowance.

method.name: get_current_budget_us
method.description: Returns the current optional IK microsecond allowance. When disabled, the full configured maximum is returned. Zero means no full-pose slots are expected from the caller's quality profile.

method.name: get_frames_observed
method.description: Returns the number of valid, nonzero processing samples observed, saturated at one million. Missing samples and disabled periods are ignored.

method.name: get_max_budget_us
method.description: Configured maximum optional work-unit allowance, in microseconds.

method.name: get_pressure_percent
method.description: Smoothed CPU process time divided by the configured target, as an integer percentage capped at 1000. A value above 100 indicates sustained main-thread process load above the target.

method.name: get_smoothed_process_us
method.description: Quarter-weight integer EMA of valid main-thread process durations, in microseconds. Zero before the first sample.

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Whether valid samples can affect the optional animation budget.

method.name: observe_process_time
method.description: Observes a bounded completed-frame CPU process duration, 0–1000000 microseconds, and returns the current optional pose-work allowance. Zero is ignored as an unknown sample. Invalid inputs return -1 without modifying history. Calls are expected once per completed frame; the caller controls timing and application of the returned budget.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears CPU pressure evidence and restores the configured maximum allowance, without changing settings or enabled state.

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Disabled governors report the maximum budget and collect no samples. Enabling after a pause resets stale pressure history.
